text.text_excerpt: OMG I tried one of the best fried Chicken Sandwiches last night, I'm so glad I got 6. I got there just in time to get the last 7 sandwiches, hallelujah! Southerns does pop-ups around the city and they sell out fast, I can see why, the hype is REAL!! I'm a fan for life! Perfectly fried boneless chicken thigh, so crispy with a great batter tossed in the spicy Otis Redding seasoning, served with housemade pickles, slaw, and a yuzu aioli on a grilled buttered sesame seed bun. I took my first bite, I remember saying mmmmmm and didn't come up for air until it had been devoured.

I've had my eye on this place for a while now! A nice Popeye's chicken sandwich usually satisfies my craving, but I wanted something a little more this Thursday evening. Quick, nice experience as they were located across from the Broad Theatre. I picked the spicy chicken sandwich with aioli fries. Upon the first bite, I was immediately floored. The flavor of this sandwich was glorious. It would have made me feel better if it were bigger, but it was still good! The fries were well seasoned too, although I wished I had asked for extra aioli. Overall, I think it's definitely worth a try!

Southern's is the best friend chicken in the city. Hands down. Over the Summer there was a "war" between restaurants on who had the best fried chicken sandwich and I ate my way through the city to seek out the best and THIS is it. Popeyes is a close second but umm the restaurant that is known for selling fried CHICKEN has sold out indefinitely of fried chicken. If that isn't irony, I don't know what is. I also had the Chick fil A spicy chicken sandwich, as well as Company Burger, Blue Oaks Tues chicken sandwich, Freret Beer Room's version and the fried chicken sliders at District Donuts.
